BiblicalUsage: Karkob is the rim or top margin — the network of brass set like a compass upon the altar of burnt offering, halfway up, to hold the fire and carry the rings.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that even the rim of the altar was made to God's pattern: nothing in His worship was left to guesswork, and the smallest margin had its place.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
